== Summary ==
Players Committee errata slip for Gravel Storm, cut unchanged at 300 dpi from page 10 of the PC's ''Decipher Errata'' sheet “Official text as of March 1, 2017” (PDF made 31 May 2017): [http://www.starwarsccg.org/virtual/DErrata.pdf source], preserved copy [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705005900/http://www.starwarsccg.org/virtual/DErrata.pdf Internet Archive]. Shown on [[Gravel Storm (PC Errata 2017 slip)]].
